additions.name: Refugium am See
additions.august_status: During 6 Jul-7 Sep 2026: Mon, Sat and Sun 12:00-21:00; Fri 16:00-21:00. Closed Tue-Thu.
additions.notes: Small, produce-led restaurant and pantry directly by Altausseer See. Strong food, lake setting and house-made products make it worth planning around its limited opening days.
additions.kind: Modern regional Austrian, pasta and cakes
additions.kid_fit: Relaxed lakeside setting; reserve for the group

additions.name: Das gute Leben
additions.august_status: Current listing has weekly rest days. Check the live schedule and reserve before fixing a date.
additions.notes: A highly regarded small restaurant in Bad Aussee with thoughtful seasonal cooking and a more local feel than the major tourist stops.
additions.kid_fit: Best for a calm family dinner rather than a rushed stop

additions.name: s'Gricht
additions.august_status: Open in summer with changing weekly hours; check the live schedule before visiting.
additions.notes: Popular central Bad Aussee restaurant with a broad menu and strong local following.
additions.route_use: Easy meal while visiting Bad Aussee

additions.name: Gasthaus Wes'n Bad Ischl
additions.notes: A small local inn in Lauffen with exceptional ratings, traditional cooking and far less tourist traffic than central Bad Ischl.
additions.kid_fit: Informal but compact; reserve for the full group
additions.route_use: Destination lunch or dinner south of Bad Ischl

additions.name: Spoarherd Gastropub
additions.august_status: Current listing shows weekly closing days; verify the selected date and reserve.
additions.notes: A modern, well-reviewed Bad Ischl gastropub for families wanting something beyond traditional inn menus.
additions.kind: Modern gastropub, burgers and Austrian influences

additions.name: Uferwirt Seeraunzn Hallstattblick
additions.august_status: Seasonal summer restaurant. Check the weekly rest day before combining it with Hallstatt.
additions.notes: A lakeside restaurant across the water from Hallstatt with a superb view and much better review profile than most central Hallstatt restaurants.
additions.kid_fit: Easy outdoor meal with space and a view
additions.route_use: Best planned meal for the Hallstatt day

additions.name: SEEplatzl
additions.august_status: Summer opening is expected; check the live schedule on the St Wolfgang day.
additions.notes: Small lakeside bistro with simple food and a strong rating, useful when a long formal lunch would derail the Schafberg day.
additions.kind: Lakeside bistro, light meals and snacks
additions.kid_fit: Casual, quick and directly by the lake

additions.name: Jausenstation Dornerhof
additions.august_status: Fri-Tue 12:00-20:00; cold platters served until 19:00. Closed Wed-Thu.
additions.notes: A tiny family-run farm stop above Wolfgangsee serving cold homemade platters, cake and drinks. The setting and welcome are the experience.
additions.kind: Farm snacks, cheese, cured meats and homemade cakes
additions.kid_fit: Informal and memorable; food is mainly cold platters
additions.route_use: Special lunch on the Wolfgangsee day

additions.name: Brauhaus Gmunden
additions.august_status: Open in summer; verify the weekly rest day before using it as the fixed arrival lunch.
additions.notes: A well-reviewed, straightforward choice near the Gmunden route, with a broad menu and easier logistics than a lakefront tourist stop.

additions.name: Wirtshaus zum Zirkelwirt
additions.august_status: Open daily in the current schedule; reserve for the transfer-day group.
additions.notes: A central old-town Austrian inn with consistently strong reviews, close enough to the walking route to avoid a separate detour.
additions.kid_fit: Classic dishes and central location; reserve

additions.name: Restaurant Appetit
additions.august_status: Open in the current summer schedule; check the weekly rest day and reserve.
additions.notes: A compact central Zell restaurant with one of the strongest combinations of rating, review volume and moderate prices.
additions.kid_fit: Welcoming but compact; book an early table
additions.route_use: Best planned dinner in central Zell

additions.name: Village Kitchen
additions.august_status: Current schedule starts service in the late afternoon on several days; verify before walking over.
additions.notes: A polished but relaxed restaurant in Schüttdorf, very close to the second home and useful when nobody wants another drive.
additions.kid_fit: Close to the accommodation; early dinner recommended

additions.name: Seewirt - Das Restaurant
additions.august_status: Open in summer with a weekly rest day; check and reserve.
additions.notes: Reliable Austrian cooking north of the Zell centre with a strong rating and enough review volume to justify planning a meal.

additions.name: Die Fliegerei
additions.august_status: Open in the current summer schedule; verify the selected day.
additions.notes: An aviation-themed restaurant by the small airfield, giving the children something interesting to watch alongside a casual meal.
additions.kid_fit: Very good: planes, casual room and familiar food

additions.name: Hilberger's Beisl
additions.august_status: Open in summer; reserve and verify the weekly rest day.
additions.notes: A popular Kaprun restaurant with a broad traditional menu and dependable review volume.
additions.route_use: Kaprun dinner after the gorge or mountain

additions.name: Gasthaus Brandlwirt
additions.august_status: Current listing shows a weekly rest day; verify before combining with Ritzensee.
additions.notes: A well-reviewed local inn close to Ritzensee, useful for turning a lake stop into a complete half-day.

additions.name: s'Stoaberg
additions.august_status: Current schedule closes around 20:00; verify the weekly rest day.
additions.notes: A casual, well-rated option in Lofer for an uncomplicated meal after Seisenbergklamm.
additions.kid_fit: Casual, moderate prices and early service

additions.name: Die St.Georgnerin
additions.august_status: Current listing shows daytime opening; verify before relying on it for the scenic-road day.
additions.notes: A small, exceptionally rated local restaurant in St Georgen, better reviewed than the obvious highway inns.
additions.route_use: Breakfast or lunch on the Grossglockner route

additions.name: SPAR express Bad Aussee

additions.notes: Fuel-station supermarket with longer hours than normal Austrian grocery shops.

additions.name: EUROSPAR Bad Ischl
additions.august_status: Mon-Sat grocery hours; closed Sunday under normal Austrian retail rules.
additions.notes: A broad-range supermarket with prepared food, useful when already in Bad Ischl.
additions.route_use: Full grocery shop during a Bad Ischl day

additions.name: SPAR express Bad Ischl
additions.august_status: Current listing: daily until 21:00. Recheck holiday hours.
additions.notes: A useful fuel-station grocery stop when standard supermarkets are closed.

additions.name: Supermarket Obertraun
additions.august_status: Limited village hours; verify before relying on it.
additions.notes: Small local grocery option for forgotten picnic items. Reviews are weak, so use it for convenience rather than a full shop.
additions.route_use: Emergency supplies on the Hallstatt or Krippenstein day

additions.name: MarktGschäftl ADEG Hallstatt
additions.august_status: Limited village hours; verify the day before.
additions.notes: The central Hallstatt grocery. Convenient but small and tourist-priced.

additions.name: ADEG St Wolfgang
additions.august_status: Mon-Sat from around 07:00; normal Sunday closure. Verify seasonal hours.
additions.notes: The most practical central grocery stop on the St Wolfgang day.

additions.name: St Wolfganger Marmeladenkuchl
additions.august_status: Current listing opens around 10:00 on trading days; verify the selected date.
additions.notes: A tiny local gourmet shop for jams and edible gifts, directly on the St Wolfgang walking route.
additions.kid_fit: Small, sweet and easy to browse

additions.name: EUROSPAR Gmunden
additions.august_status: Mon-Sat trading hours; closed Sunday under normal retail rules.
additions.notes: A useful first large grocery stop if you pause in Gmunden on the drive to Altaussee.

additions.name: Manner Pop-Up Shop Zell am See
additions.august_status: Open through the trip: Mon-Fri 10:00-20:00, Sat 10:00-18:00, closed Sun.
additions.notes: A fun Austrian-brand shop with unusual Manner flavors, pick-and-mix sweets, gifts and branded accessories.

additions.name: C&A Kids Store Zell am See
additions.august_status: Mon-Sat retail hours; closed Sunday.
additions.notes: A practical children-focused clothing branch close to the second accommodation.
additions.kid_fit: Useful for missing layers or replacement clothes

additions.name: Bründl Sports Kaprun Outlet
additions.august_status: Current listing: Mon-Sat from around 09:00; closed Sunday.
additions.notes: The best nearby substitute for a large outdoor-sports shopping stop, with outlet pricing on alpine clothing and equipment.

additions.name: Lidl Zell am See
additions.august_status: Mon-Sat grocery hours; closed Sunday.
additions.notes: A large budget supermarket very close to the second accommodation.

additions.name: Billa Shop Zell am See
additions.august_status: Current listing: daily until 23:00. Recheck before relying on Sunday opening.
additions.notes: Fuel-station Billa shop with much longer hours than standard supermarkets.

additions.name: SPAR Kaprun
additions.august_status: Mon-Sat from around 07:15; closed Sunday under normal retail rules.
additions.notes: A well-reviewed supermarket on the northern edge of Kaprun, convenient after the gorge.

additions.name: 24/7 Smart Shop Saalfelden
additions.august_status: Listed as open 24 hours; verify access/payment requirements before relying on it.
additions.notes: An unattended small grocery option for after-hours basics north of Zell.

additions.name: SPAR Lofer
additions.august_status: Mon-Sat from around 07:15; closed Sunday under normal retail rules.
additions.notes: The strongest normal supermarket option in Lofer for picnic food or supplies.

additions.name: Frische Eier 24h Lofer
additions.august_status: Listed as a 24-hour self-service farm stop.
additions.notes: A tiny self-service local egg stop by the farm, memorable for children and useful if cooking at the accommodation.

additions.name: Teekorb & Tridor Roastery
additions.august_status: Current hours: Mon and Fri 08:00-17:00; Tue-Thu 08:00-16:00; Sat hours vary; closed Sun.
additions.notes: A genuine local coffee roastery and tea specialist selling beans, tea, spices, mugs and gifts.
additions.kind: Coffee roastery, tea and regional gifts

additions.name: Salzkontor Hallstatt
additions.august_status: Seasonal shop hours; verify on the Hallstatt morning.
additions.notes: A more specific Hallstatt souvenir stop focused on salt and handmade soaps rather than generic tourist merchandise.
additions.kind: Local salt, soap and gift shop

additions.name: Handdruck Sekyra
additions.august_status: Showroom visits and demonstrations are by prior appointment; normally closed weekends.
additions.notes: One of the last traditional Ausseer hand-printing workshops, producing unique fabrics and local-pattern accessories with historic printing blocks.
additions.kid_fit: Arrange a short workshop visit in advance
additions.route_use: Distinctive local craft stop worth planning

additions.name: Dachstein Giant Ice Cave
additions.weather: Dry or mixed; mountain weather matters
additions.august_status: Open daily during the trip. In the 4 July-13 September timetable, cave tours run 08:40-16:30. The cave is about -2 C.
additions.notes: A 50-minute guided walk through huge ice formations. Allow 15-20 minutes uphill from the cable-car station, bring warm layers and grippy shoes, and do not try to combine every Krippenstein attraction in one day.
additions.kid_fit: Excellent spectacle; carrier needed for Roni

additions.name: Dachstein Mammoth Cave
additions.weather: Dry or mixed; mountain weather matters
additions.august_status: Open daily during the trip; the published 2026 season is 9 May-1 November. Cave tours operate in the daytime timetable.
additions.notes: A giant dry cave with dramatic passages rather than ice. Choose this if the older children are cave enthusiasts; for one cave only, the Giant Ice Cave is the stronger first choice.

additions.name: Koppenbruller Cave
additions.weather: Cloudy or light rain; avoid flooding weather
additions.august_status: Open daily during the trip; the published 2026 season is 1 May-27 September. Tours can be affected by high water.
additions.notes: A lower-valley active water cave reached without the Krippenstein cable cars. It stays around 6 C and makes a shorter cave day than the high-mountain pair.
additions.kid_fit: Shorter cave option for all three children

additions.name: Abarena All-Weather Family Park
additions.august_status: Open daily 10:00-18:00 during the trip under the published 3 July-13 September 2026 main-season timetable.
additions.notes: A large play park with indoor and outdoor zones near Wolfgangsee. It is especially useful when the forecast is changeable and the adults want a low-planning day.
additions.kind: Indoor and outdoor family play park
additions.kid_fit: One of the strongest all-ages backups

additions.name: Sommerrodelbahn Strobl
additions.august_status: Normally open daily in July and August, weather permitting. Check the same morning because rain can stop operation.
additions.notes: A pair of summer toboggan tracks beside Wolfgangsee. Check minimum ages and riding rules for Roni before buying tickets; combine it with St. Wolfgang or a lakeside stop.
additions.kid_fit: Strong for ages 6-7; age 3 depends on riding rules

additions.name: Museum of Vehicles, Technology and Aviation
additions.august_status: Open daily 09:00-18:00 during the trip under the published April-October timetable.
additions.notes: A collection of roughly 300 exhibits, from bicycles and fire engines to cars and aircraft. A practical rainy-day option that is more child-focused than another town museum.
additions.kid_fit: Particularly good for Guy and the 7-year-old

additions.name: Urzeitwald Gosau
additions.august_status: The park advertises daily good-weather summer opening, but its detailed season page is not yet updated for 2026. Verify before relying on it.
additions.notes: A small prehistoric-themed forest play park with water activities. It could pair naturally with Gosausee, but should remain a reserve until the 2026 timetable is confirmed.
additions.kid_fit: Very good for all three children

additions.name: Kitzlochklamm
additions.august_status: Open daily 08:00-18:00 during the trip; last admission 17:00. Published 2026 season: 17 May-30 September.
additions.notes: A dramatic gorge in Taxenbach with boardwalks, tunnels and many steps. It is a strong alternative to Seisenbergklamm, not an extra gorge to squeeze into the same day.
additions.kid_fit: Great for older children; carry Roni when needed

additions.name: Lamprechtshohle
additions.weather: Cloudy or light rain; avoid heavy rain
additions.august_status: Open daily 08:30-19:00 in the May-October timetable, but it may close after heavy rain.
additions.notes: A 700-metre visitor route inside a cool show cave, with stairs and about 70 metres of ascent. It is farther from Zell and less suitable for Roni, so keep it as a special-interest reserve.

additions.name: Votter's Oldtimer Museum
additions.august_status: Open daily 10:00-20:00 in July and August.
additions.notes: More than 200 historic cars, motorcycles, scooters, radios and other objects in central Kaprun. It is an easy indoor stop rather than a full-day plan.
additions.kid_fit: Easy and visual for all ages

additions.name: Rauris Hochalm Family Mountain
additions.august_status: Open during the trip under the published 30 May-4 October 2026 season. Birds-of-prey shows are scheduled at 11:00 and 14:30.
additions.notes: A cable-car family mountain with birds of prey, gold and mineral panning, a forest trail and water play. It is a longer drive, but distinct enough from the other mountain days to be a real alternative.
additions.kind: Family mountain and birds of prey
additions.kid_fit: Strong shared-interest day for all three children
additions.route_use: Full family day when mountain weather is good

additions.name: Strandbad Zell am See
additions.august_status: Open daily 09:00-19:00 during the trip under the published 4 July-30 August 2026 timetable. Hours can change with weather.
additions.notes: The central lake lido has family facilities and makes a simple recovery afternoon. Use it alone or after one short morning activity rather than treating it as a rushed add-on.

additions.name: Kaprun Castle Family Adventure
additions.august_status: A guided children's castle adventure is scheduled Tuesday 25 August 2026, 09:00-11:30, for ages 6 and over. Advance registration is required.
additions.notes: A date-specific children's programme rather than a normal drop-in attraction. It suits Guy, while one adult would need a separate plan with Roni.
additions.kid_fit: Excellent for Guy; not suitable for age 3
